=== tool
{
  "tool": "claude_send",
  "description": "Send a part of this session's work (a plan step, a diff, a finding, your last answer) to the Claude Code session paired with it (the claude-inbox context), for Claude to validate, to take as context, or to answer a question about. Only when the user asks for it, or to reply to its answer in a peer turn. Needs a paired Claude Code session: without one it fails, and the user pairs from Claude. Claude's answer comes back later as the claude-review context (a validate's wakes you): don't wait or poll. Never send secrets or the whole conversation.",
  "params": {
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "validate",
        "context",
        "question"
      ],
      "required": true,
      "description": "validate: check this part and answer with a verdict; context: for Claude to know, no answer expected; question: answer the question in text"
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "required": true,
      "description": "A short one-line title for the part; Claude's answer names it"
    },
    "text": {
      "type": "string",
      "required": true,
      "description": "The part itself and what to check or ask, as Claude should read it; name the files, functions or diff range to look at. A long text goes to a file Claude reads"
    }
  },
  "label": "sent to Claude",
  "preview": "validate: cache step 2"
}
=== command
{
  "command": "/claude",
  "description": "the paired Claude Code session: status; validate|context <text>, last: send to it; install-skill: install Claude's chi-peer skill",
  "anytime": true
}
=== annotation
{
  "annotation": "Confirm with Claude",
  "command": "/claude validate"
}
=== peer_source
{
  "peer_source": "claude-review",
  "label": "Claude"
}
=== hook
{
  "hook": "before_turn",
  "priority": 100
}
=== hook
{
  "hook": "after_turn",
  "priority": 100
}
=== USAGE
usage: /claude — whether a Claude Code session is paired; /claude validate <text> | context <text> — send the text to it; /claude last — send the last answer as context; /claude install-skill — install Claude's chi-peer skill, which pairs
